source_description: Preserve the SAME entire rifle woodbrown/gray atlas. Keep broad original warmbrown left stock paint, its upper dark wash, original uppermiddle darkgray panel/cutout, existing upperright gray/pale bands and thin shaded marks, central brown strip with its original weak dark dashes, lower-middle gray framed field and its original tiny fine gray cadences, lower-right gray rectangular field with its old tiny pale edge ticks. Preserve weak source phase in all dark dashes and tiny gray ticks; none becomes a label, knob, bead or new physical assembly. The old small gray/dark mark in left brown lower field around native x40..56,y48..63 stays the same indistinct sourcepaint wash. Uppergray and wood remain dim fine hand-painted shading, never hard engraved or photographed grain.

source_description: Preserve the SAME entire source submachinegun woodbrown/gray atlas. Keep ONE broad left brown stock paint with its original irregular broad upperboundary/softshadow, ONE original upper-middle horizontal gray tube paint with its old circular-gray left edge and existing dim long inset shading, original dark lowergray/cutout field and tiny source spots, lower middle brown band with its original weak horizontal dark/pale strokes, and right vertical gray painted frame plus exact old thin edge strips. Small round pale pigment near native x91,y11 and small patches above/around the cutout remain soft original paint at their exact native positions, not newly detailed screws. Do not regularize the old tiny right edge cadence. Gray is soft matte steel-colored paint, woodbrown is dim old brushpaint without woodrings/knots/photo grain.

source_description: Preserve the SAME entire olive/brown/gray bazooka painted atlas. Keep original upperleft olive rectangles and small soft-shadow fields, original uppermiddle broad brown grip paint field and its tiny weak pale/dark spots, existing upperright pointed gray horizontal tube paint, original second smaller brown grip field at middle-right with its weak old dark dots, the original small right olive panels, and the complete lower horizontal olive tube paint with its original pale seam positions and tiny subtle paint ticks. Every existing dim dot/fleck remains sourcepaint at the same count/phase; no new fasteners, engraved symbols or extra hardware. Both brown fields retain the original soft mottled brown brushwash, lower olive field retains original broad dim gradients and thin original pale seams. Gray pointed field is source painted gray silhouette, not a newly modeled projectile. Preserve black authored support and the true upperleft sourceA0 cutout independently; do not call all black transparent.
